title: Normalized exact integral section realization
statement: For a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l and a scheme X, let B be the pulled-back continuous condensed valuation ring [det-prop-sfb-qlbar-colimit-x-integral-limit]. There is a specified exact equivalence from internal B-modules to ordinary module sheaves over the inverse limit of the constant positive valuation-ring quotients [def-sfb-adic-stratified-perfect-data]. It is restriction along the spectral/absolute point identification, the section-action equivalence, and restriction along the finite-projection-normalized coefficient isomorphisms. Its derived equivalence localizes this same functor termwise.

proof.text: The spectral and absolute coefficient topologies agree. Apply the resulting equality in monoid objects and pull it back to X. Restriction along this coefficient isomorphism is an equivalence.

Compose the actual section-action functor with the two restrictions along the normalized coefficient isomorphisms. Each is an additive equivalence, so their composite and its termwise derived localization are equivalences.
